item.title: California Bans AI‑Only Layoffs, Grants Worker Rights
item.description: California's new law bars employers from using AI as the basis for firing or disciplining staff, bans bathroom surveillance, and demands transparency.

item.title: Newsom Vetoes Smart‑Glasses Privacy Bill in California
item.description: Governor Gavin Newsom vetoed SB‑1130, a bill that would ban recording with smart glasses and require visible indicators, sparking tech‑industry debate.
